paper.title_en: Triple-Higgs production: a window on the Higgs potential and anomalous top-Higgs couplings
paper.abstract_en: We present a comprehensive study of triple-Higgs production within the $κ$-framework as a probe of the Higgs potential and anomalous top-Higgs couplings. At leading order, we derive compact parametrisations of the inclusive $gg\to3h$ cross section in terms of the trilinear and quartic Higgs self-coupling modifiers $κ_3$ and $κ_4$, the top-quark Yukawa coupling modifier $κ_t$, and the anomalous two-top-two-Higgs and two-top-three-Higgs coupling modifiers $κ_{2t}$ and $κ_{3t}$. These parametrisations allow for a fast and accurate interpretation of current and future LHC measurements. Applying them to LHC Run 2 data and high-luminosity LHC projections, we quantify the impact of $κ_t$, $κ_{2t}$, and $κ_{3t}$ on the constraints on $κ_3$ and $κ_4$, and derive the first direct constraint on $κ_{3t}$ from existing LHC data. We further show that parameter points yielding nearly identical inclusive rates can give rise to different kinematic distributions, demonstrating the potential of differential measurements to resolve degeneracies and enhance the sensitivity of future triple-Higgs searches.
